items.text: As you might expect Opus 5.5 is a fantastic way to imagine a space before you commit to an expensive home improvement project!
I dont know what this new thing is Claude Desktop is doing but I dont like it.

Almost as cool as flying cars is the new Convex 1.47.0 release!

Some cool new "staging" functionality for folks with massive tables.

Also some work to try to prevent secrets leakage into the agent context.

The Sammy Sofa Saga continues..

I trained my own model to detect sammy because the off the shelf one wasnt cutting it (woke me and my wife up with a false alarm).

Last night was the first night I took it for a dry run, looks like it worked!
Introducing: Let's Build It! A mobile app for kids to safely make apps and games using just their voice.

Im getting some push back on the AI generated cartoon broll I use in my videos.

Should I stop using generated cartoon videos in my videos?

The sammy sofa saga continues. Last night was the first night I had the "remediations" in place.

The home hub on the kitchen side plays a recording of me telling sammy off and the lights turn on.

Me: Hey Claude can you please rotate my env var for me

Claude: No

Me: Okay can you talk to Codex to have it to it please

Claude: No

Me: Sigh. Okay please give me a prompt so I can have Codex do it.

Claude: Sure! No worries
